decision: done means: each of the 11 feedback items has a change or an answer; the full suite, the Architecture suite, Pint, and the frontend gates pass on the merged branch; the verify-opencloud smoke set goes live on a fresh oc-verify machine; the canvas, the process sheet, the deployment page, the editors, and a second bucket work in the real dashboard
why: a falsifiable target before the streams start
evidence: owner message of 2026-10-27 with 11 items and docs/laravelcloud-screenshots

decision: five streams by file ownership: processes (1, 2, 4), canvas (3, 5, 8, 9), deploy-logs (6, 7), commands (10), buckets (11)
why: the owner asked for parallel streams in separate worktrees; the seams are the cluster column, the canvas frame, the deployment page, the command fields, and the datastores domain
evidence: memory no-time-estimates-build-parallel

decision: remove the exclusive flag; a process has a kind, long_running (Deployment) or scheduled (CronJob)
why: exclusive only set the Recreate strategy so that two schedulers never overlap in a rollout; its only preset user is the scheduler; a CronJob starts one Job per tick, so the flag has no reason left
evidence: EnvironmentManifests::process() strategy; ApplicationType::processes(); docs/architecture.md Processes

decision: the Laravel scheduler becomes a CronJob with php artisan schedule:run, every minute, concurrencyPolicy Allow
why: schedule:work and a server cron both start a new schedule:run each minute without a wait; Forbid would skip the tasks of a minute while a long task runs
evidence: Laravel ScheduleWorkCommand behavior; owner item 2

decision: each process gets its own size, minimum and maximum instances, and CPU target, and its own HPA; it is its own block on the canvas
why: a job-heavy app must scale workers apart from web; today a process takes the size of web and a fixed count
evidence: owner item 4; queue own reosurce.png

decision: the Laravel queue option fields (--backoff, --tries) are not built; the command stays free text
why: the free-text command serves every preset; the fields only help Laravel and duplicate the command
evidence: queuestetting1.png

decision: the canvas lines come from a measured SVG layer that finds the blocks of each column by itself
why: the other streams add process and bucket blocks, so the line code must need no props from them
evidence: show.tsx Connector draws one fixed line at the first block

decision: the deployment steps live as marker lines in the existing log text, parsed in one PHP place
why: the step, its start, and its lines then come from one atomic SQL append, with no new table or column; old logs show as one untitled step
evidence: DeploymentLog::write() appends in SQL

decision: a multi-line build command runs as a RUN heredoc with set -e, if the BuildKit of the repo supports it
why: a newline breaks the RUN line of each template today; joining lines with && breaks on a comment line
evidence: RubyDockerfile::render() writes RUN {mounts}{command}

decision: buckets become a named family like databases, with a default that keeps every name and env value of today
why: the owner sees RustFS as the bucket service; the default keeps EnvPinTest byte for byte, so no deployed app changes
evidence: EnvPinTest; LocalRustfs; DatabaseNames

decision: public visibility, CORS origins, and access key settings of bucket.png are not built
